# AI v2 design todo, part A (design to update)

# A.16 AiBoardAssistant (`AiBoardAssistant.dc.html`)

Dock, chat, board health and Docs AI entry points live on. The invariant "AI proposes, you apply" is **reversed**: the Board AI acts at once on reversible things and says what it did; it describes and asks first for delete, remove a member, pause every AI, merge. `scope.work` is false and `draft_kinds` is empty.
